title: Spin-off Deals from Africa-Singapore Business Forum
what_it_is: Spin-off Deals from Africa-Singapore Business Forum

sections.label: Africa growth drivers
sections.summary: Africa's young population, growing middle class consumption and rapid urbanisation are driving growth, forecast to exceed the global average over five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Positive demographics of a young population, a significantly large young population, growing middle class consumption and rapid urbanisation are driving growth in Africa.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: As a region, it has been forecast to grow faster than the global average over the next five years.

sections.label: Singapore Africa bilateral agreements
sections.summary: In 2016 Singapore signed Bilateral Investment Treaties with Nigeria and Mozambique, a Double Taxation Agreement with Ethiopia and an Air Services Agreement with Nigeria.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: In 2016, for example, we signed Bilateral Investment Treaties with Nigeria and another one with Mozambique.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: We also signed an Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement with Ethiopia and an Air Services Agreement with Nigeria.

sections.label: Singapore firms in Africa
sections.summary: Hyflux, CrimsonLogic and YuuZoo have undertaken township, e-government and e-commerce projects in Tanzania, Kenya, Rwanda and Nigeria.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: For example, Hyflux has embarked on its first township development project in Morogoro in Tanzania.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: E-government solutions company CrimsonLogic has implemented electronic platforms in Kenya and Rwanda to digitise trade documentation in these countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: One of our SMEs, YuuZoo, a digital platform provider, has also launched an SME-focused e-commerce platform in Nigeria.

sections.label: SME opportunities in Africa
sections.summary: The passage asks whether more Singaporean SMEs will be involved in Africa and notes opportunities in agri-business, infrastructure, urban solutions, logistics, ICT and oil and gas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Will more Singaporean SMEs be involved in Africa and to what extent may they benefit from this bilateral trade with Africa?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: There are opportunities in various sectors, including agri-businesses, infra-structure projects, urban solutions, logistics, info-communication technology as well as the oil and gas sector.
